fitMetadata.procedure: w2_graphProximity fixed at 0.15 (no train query supplies a seed entity, so it is inert on this text-only eval set and excluded from grid search to avoid a meaningless fit). Remaining 0.85 mass grid-searched in 0.05 steps over w1/w3/w4/w5 with a floor of w1 >= 0.34 (BM25 must carry the primary lexical signal; unconstrained search could zero it out via train-set score-tie artifacts). Objective: maximize mean P@5 on TRAIN, tie-broken by mean nDCG@10. Holdout split is never touched by this script.
